name: Chatagentive
author: Daniyal Aslam

sections.description:
Chatagentive is a powerful, production-ready WordPress plugin that enables seamless integration of the Chatagentive AI chatbot on your website. Improve customer support, boost engagement, and automate your communications with an intelligent, customizable chat interface.

Key Features:
* Easy setup with just an Agent ID.
* Toggle chatbot visibility directly from the WordPress admin panel.
* Secure and optimized loading of the Chatagentive widget.
* Clean, accessible, and translation-ready.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/chatagentive directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the Settings -> Chatagentive menu to configure your Agent ID.
sections.faq:
Where do I find my Agent ID?

You can find your Agent ID in your Chatagentive Dashboard under Agent Settings.
